_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/attachments/test_become_aura.py. t_ba_rite is Necromancy's second paragraph on a bare enchantment: its enters trigger makes it an Aura, returns the target creature card and attaches it, and its leaves trigger has that creature's controller sacrifice it. t_ba_rite_no_aura is the near miss -- the same card without become_aura -- kept live so the 704.5m assertion is measured against an enchantment the state-based action really does leave alone.

cards.name: Test Necromantic Rite
cards.oracle_text: When this enchantment enters, if it's on the battlefield, it becomes an Aura with "enchant creature put onto the battlefield with Test Necromantic Rite." Put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control and attach this enchantment to it. When this enchantment leaves the battlefield, that creature's controller sacrifices it.
